Welcome to BosilunLife Eco-Luxury Affiliate Partner Program! These Terms and Conditions govern participation in the BosilunLife Affiliate Program (the “Program”) by individuals or entities acting as affiliates (“you” or “Affiliate”) who promote BosilunLife’s products or services on behalf of BosilunLife (“we,” “us,” or “Merchant”). By joining or using the Program, you agree to be legally bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to all of the terms, you may not participate in the Program.

1. Approval of Your Registration
All affiliate applications are subject to review. We reserve the right to approve or decline any registration at our sole discretion. If your application isn’t accepted, we truly appreciate your interest and hope to connect again in the future.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

  • Once approved, you’ll receive an automatically generated affiliate link. You can also create custom links for specific products or collections through your Dashboard.
  • If a customer clicks on multiple affiliate links, the most recent one (last click) is the one that earns the commission.
  • You may be assigned a unique coupon code. Coupon usage rules and eligibility will be shown in your Dashboard.
  • Please do not promote coupons that haven’t been specifically assigned to you.
  • You’re welcome to promote your affiliate link on social media platforms, or through offline channels such as printed ads, magazines, or newspapers - as long as your content follows our terms and local advertising laws.

3. Commissions and Payment

  • You will earn a 13% commission on every successful order made by a customer you refer through your affiliate link or assigned coupon code.
  • Commission is calculated based on the order value, excluding taxes, shipping fees, and other extra charges.To receive a commission, you must enter your payment details in the Settings section.
  • You can choose to be paid via PayPal or bank transfer.
    The payment schedule is shared in the Affiliate Guide and may vary based on your chosen method.
  • Commissions are only paid for transactions that have been successfully completed and not refunded or charged back.
  • We apply a fair use policy, which means BosilunLife has the right to review any referred order to ensure its validity.
  • You can track your earnings in the Commission tab, and all processed payments will appear in the Payment tab.

4. Marketing Tools
We may provide you with promotional media - such as banners, logos, or specific campaign materials - through the Marketing Tool tab in your dashboard. You can download these assets or copy the HTML embed code to share them on your affiliate channels.

5. Cookie
We use a cookie to track people who click your affiliate link or use your coupon.

  • The cookie stays active for 365 days.
  • If a customer makes a purchase during that time, you’ll earn a commission, even if they don’t click the link again.
  • If cookies are blocked or deleted by the customer, we can’t track the referral, and no commission will be paid.

6. Removal from Referral Program
If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: antonio@bosilunlife.com

7. Prohibited Activities
To maintain the integrity of BosilunLife brand, affiliates must not engage in any of the following:

  • Using spam (unsolicited emails or messages) to promote affiliate links.
  • Misrepresenting BosilunLife products or making false claims.
  • Offering cash-back, rewards, or incentives not provided by BosilunLife.
  • Using cookie stuffing or any form of fraud to generate commissions.
  • We review affiliate activity regularly to ensure fair use. If any of these rules are broken, it may lead to suspension or removal from the program and cancellation of unpaid commissions.

8. Relationship of the Parties
Participation in the Affiliate Program does not create any partnership, joint venture, agency, franchise, or employment relationship between you and BosilunLife. You operate as an independent party and do not have the authority to represent or bind BosilunLife in any way.

9. Termination and Modification
BosilunLife reserves the right to modify or terminate the Affiliate Program and these Terms at any time. You will be notified of any changes by email or through your affiliate dashboard. By continuing to participate in the Program after changes are posted, you accept the updated terms.

10. Confidentiality
Affiliates may have access to confidential information such as business strategies, pricing, and customer data. You agree to keep this information strictly confidential and not disclose it to any third party, during or after your participation in the Program.

11. Limitation of Liability
BosilunLife shall not be liable for any indirect, special, or consequential damages arising from or related to your participation in the Program. Our total liability will not exceed the total amount of commissions paid to you under this agreement.

12. Governing Law
These Terms and Conditions shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of Portugal and applicable laws of the European Union, without regard to conflict of law principles.

Thank you for being part of the BosilunLife Eco-Luxury Affiliate Partner Program!
We’re excited to have you on board and look forward to a successful partnership. You can return to these Terms at any time for reference. If you have any questions or need support, feel free to contact us at antonio@bosilunlife.com for support.
